name: Paper Tear
description: The first clip tears in two along a ragged line, and the halves are pulled apart to reveal the second one. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: roughness
params.description: How far the tear wanders from the middle, relative to the frame height

params.name: tilt
params.description: How much the top of each half leans away first, so that the tear opens from the top

params.name: rim
params.description: Width of the white torn edge, relative to the frame height

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the paper fibers on the torn edges

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip (alpha: strength)
